title: Global web console labels repo-local work as Global work
description: Evidence: loadLiveConsoleData always loads repo-local work list before checking global scope and returns it as data.work; OverviewPage renders data.work under the card title Global work before the actual globalQueues view. Impact: global mode can show only the launcher workspace as global work, misleading operators and duplicating/conflicting with real cross-project queues.
acceptanceCriteria: Global scope omits repo-local data.work or labels it explicitly as current workspace.
The global work section is driven by globalQueues, with tests proving global overview does not present launcher-only work as cross-project work.
